create_text_logger_hook: create a TextLoggerHook instance to log training metrics to terminal and JSON file during model training
configure_logger_output_directory: configure the TextLoggerHook out_dir parameter to save logs to a custom directory with file client support
customize_logging_interval: customize the logging interval and experiment name interval parameters to control how frequently logs are printed
log_training_metrics: use the log method to record learning rate, memory usage, time statistics, and custom metrics during training
dump_json_logs: dump training logs in JSON format to a timestamped log file for later analysis and visualization
